headline: President Biden cancels several earlier executive orders about how federal agencies make and manage regulations.
what_it_does: This order revokes, or cancels, certain earlier executive orders dealing with federal regulation. Those earlier orders set rules for how federal agencies create, review, or manage regulations. The title does not list which orders are canceled or describe what replaces them.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies no longer have to follow the requirements of the canceled orders when making or reviewing rules.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses and others subject to federal regulations
who_it_affects.how: How new rules are made and reviewed may change, though the title alone does not show specific effects.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2021; the title does not give a separate start date.
